descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器表明[From.GetStarName]正准备喷发另一场超强耀斑，正如摧毁了[From.From.GetName]上的远古文明那次一样。我们必须在此之前寻找方法保护我们的殖民地。
descriptions.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [From.GetStarName] is preparing for another superflare event, not unlike the one that destroyed the ancient civilization on [From.From.GetName]. We need to find a way to shield our colony before the flare erupts.

descriptions.zh:
科学家们对[From.GetName]上过去存在的文明是如何消失的感到困惑不解。他们提议对星球上留下的初级机器人进行更加深入的硬件分析，试图寻找一些线索。

奖励：£society£ §G社会学研究§!
descriptions.en:
Researchers are baffled by the lack of explanation for the disappearance of the past civilization on [From.GetName]. They propose a more intensive hardware analysis of the ancient robots they left behind, in an attempt to shed some light on this mystery.

Reward: £society£  §GSociety Research§!

descriptions.zh: 一系列原因不明的不服从行为正在[From.GetName]上兴起。殖民者们表现出奇怪的行为，通常由困惑开始，随着时间演变成极度的暴躁与侵略性。我们必须在局面失去控制之前找到原因。
descriptions.en: A streak of unexplained civil disobedience is sweeping across [From.GetName]. Colonists are exhibiting strange, erratic behavior that usually begins with general confusion and escalates over time to extreme agitation and violence. We must find the cause of this behavior, before things get out of hand.

descriptions.zh: [from.GetStarName]星系中出现了不可能的重力读数。一定是有什么东西在干扰我们的传感器。
descriptions.en: Impossible gravitational readings have been registered in the [from.GetStarName] system. Something must be interfering with our sensors.

descriptions.zh: 我们决定用致命手段来提取迷途变形虫幼体的生物数据。我们将派人将其捕获，并解剖其遗骸。
descriptions.en: We have decided to extract biological data from the lost juvenile Space Amoeba by fatal means. We will send a task force to capture the creature, and dissect its remains.

descriptions.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的环形世界上的冷冻舱内，有着数百个仍然存活的冷冻克隆人。与其让他们像同类一样慢慢死亡，我们的生物学家提议解冻他们。
descriptions.en: There are hundreds of still-living clones sealed in cryostasis chambers on the ruined Ring World surrounding [From.GetName]. Rather than let them slowly die off like many of their comrades, our biologists propose thawing them out.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]发现了一艘瘫痪的机器人战舰，正被星球的毒性大气层慢慢腐蚀。我们应该趁它尚未完全报废之前尝试回收它。
descriptions.en: A disabled robotic warship has been found on [From.GetName], where it is slowly being dissolved by the planet's toxic atmosphere. We should attempt to recover it, before it is rendered wholly inoperable.

links.script: ship_event = { id = distar.156 scopes = { from = from } }

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的地表上曾经存在过一种蛞蝓般的生物，与一种爬虫动物形成了共生关系。它会附在宿主的脑干上，将野生的蜥蜴变成了会使用工具的智慧生物。出于某种原因，这些蛞蝓终止了共生关系，而其爬虫动物宿主也变回了单纯的动物。

我们的科学家希望进一步研究星球上的神经蛞蝓，以便更好地了解它们一同建造的失落文明的历史。
descriptions.en:
A symbiotic relationship between a reptilian species and a slug-like creature that attaches to the brain stem of its host once flourished on the surface of [From.GetName], transforming the bestial reptiles into tool-using sapients. Something caused these creatures to terminate their symbiotic relationship, and the reptilian hosts reverted back into mere animals.

Our scientists would like to study the neural slugs still found on the planet more closely, in order to better understand the history of the lost civilization they built together.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[ratling_capital.GetName]§!上的垃圾堆中出现了智慧生物。我们的科学家想知道，这些被称为鼠人的生物究竟是曾控制这些星系的星际文明的后代，还是另有其它的起源。

我们可以选择任何有独立鼠人居住的星球来进行这项研究。
descriptions.en:
Sapient creatures have emerged from the scrap piles on §Y[ratling_capital.GetName]§!. Our scientists are curious whether these aliens, dubbed Ketlings, are descendants of the space-faring civilization that once spanned these systems, or if they have another origin entirely.

We should be able to choose any planet inhabited by autonomous Ketlings to conduct this study.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§!，一颗§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]§!星系内的行星，近日被观察到正以三个月为周期，在§Y虚境星球§!与§Y盖亚星球§!状态间循环。

我们的物理学家应该可以开发出相应的办法，将其锁定在其中一种状态之中，使之永久处于§Y盖亚星球§!状态，不再变回另一种状态。
descriptions.en:
§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§!, a planet in the §Y[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]§! System has been observed to phase-shift between a §YShrouded World§! and §YGaia World§! on a three month cycle.

Our physicists should be able to devise a way to lock the planet in one of its states, freezing it as a §YGaia World§!, and preventing it from shifting back.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于§H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the §H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§! system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

Any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years, but this should give us a significant headstart.

descriptions.zh: 无人机被摧毁之后，我们即可对小行星内部进行进一步的调查了。
descriptions.en: Once the drones have been destroyed, the asteroid they lurked in can be investigated more thoroughly.

descriptions.zh:
[impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName]成功从[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]剧毒表面发现的异常顽强的有机体上取回了一份样本。

我们的生物学家想对其进行更为详尽的研究。
descriptions.en:
The [impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName] has successfully retrieved a specimen of the incredibly robust organism found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName]'s toxic surface.

Our biologists would like to study it in greater detail.

descriptions.zh:
[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上发现的生命体，展现出了极为出众的在凶险环境中生长的能力。

看来若想揭开其基因、细胞与生化系统中隐藏的谜题，是不得不进行进一步研究了。
descriptions.en:
The lifeform found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] has been shown to possess an extraordinary capacity for growth in hostile environments.

Further study is warranted, if our biologists are to unravel the mysteries of its genetic, cellular and biochemical processes.

descriptions.zh: 对此软体类物种进行研究，试着搞明白他们是怎样如此轻松地发现矿脉的。
descriptions.en: Research the molluscoid species and attempt to discover their means of locating mineral deposits with such ease.

descriptions.zh: 立刻着手将这些软体类矿工整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。
descriptions.en: Commence the integration of the molluscoid miners into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society.

descriptions.zh: 开始研究并应用可以高速勘探地下地形并制图的系统，以求提升矿物生产效率。
descriptions.en: Begin research and implementation of a system able to swiftly chart underground terrain, with the end goal of improving mineral production.

descriptions.zh: 开始着手撬开在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子。
descriptions.en: Begin the efforts to open the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 研究在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子，以查明其内容物。
descriptions.en: Research the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName] to ascertain its contents.

descriptions.zh: 观察[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近发现的空间裂隙，等着看里面会冒出什么东西。
descriptions.en: Observe the rift in space discovered near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] and await whatever comes out of it, if anything.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]星系内的L-星龙似乎很温顺——至少目前如此。

如果它有智慧，我们或许可以与其结盟并从中受益。
descriptions.en:
The L-Drake in the [From.GetName] system appears docile - for now.

If it is intelligent, we could benefit from attempting to ally with the beast.

descriptions.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
descriptions.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

descriptions.zh: 只要发射一个探测器，我们就将最终揭开谜底：眼前这颗毫无生机的荒芜行星是否就是马达科-沃尔传说中的天堂。
descriptions.en: Sending a probe to the planet's surface will allow us to decide once and for all whether the desolate barren world that lies before us is in fact all that remains of the Mardak Vol's mythical paradise.

descriptions.zh: 一座废弃的外星平台漂浮在[star_lifting_star.GetName]的轨道上。如果我们能设法修复它，可是我们改善并利用恒星提供的能源。
descriptions.en: A decrepit platform of ancient alien design orbits [star_lifting_star.GetName]. If we could find a way to repair it, it would allow us to improve and harness the star's energy outflow.

descriptions.zh: 一座废弃的外星平台漂浮在[star_lifting_star.GetName]的轨道上。它有一些非常实验性的微波束科技，有改造成武器的潜力。
descriptions.en: A decrepit platform of ancient alien design orbits [star_lifting_star.GetName]. It has some highly experimental microwave beam technology with potential for weaponization.

descriptions.zh: 位于[big_rip_planet.GetName]轨道上的废弃观测站的数据储存装置已被清空。我们必须派人到星球上去，才能弄明白这里原先居住的智慧生物出了什么事。
descriptions.en: The data storage units on the observation post orbiting [big_rip_planet.GetName] have been wiped. We will have to send a team planetside if we want to get to the bottom of what happened to the intelligent lifeforms previously inhabiting the planet.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，令科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]大感困惑，认为它里面一定藏着什么有价值的东西。
descriptions.en: The discovery of a tiny metal cube with different colored sides has mystified Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName], who is certain it hides something of value inside.

descriptions.zh: 星系中有数颗恒星开始奇怪地悸动。船员们担心这些读数是仪器故障造成的，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]想要详细调查其中一颗恒星。
descriptions.en: Several stars in the galaxy have begun to pulsate oddly. The crew have raised concerns that these readings were caused by a sensory malfunction, but officer [Root.GetLeaderName] would like to investigate one of the stars more closely.

descriptions.zh:
某种未知生命体被困在冰层之中，没人知道这生命体是从何处而来、到底经历了多么漫长的岁月。

我们的研究员已做好充分准备，打算复活这个生命体。
descriptions.en:
Trapped within in a mountainous slab of ice are the remains of a lifeform, the likes of which have never seen before. Who knows how far it has traveled through space and time.

Our researchers have made the necessary preparations to bring it back to life.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上收集了用于测试的外星武器残骸，以供分析。
descriptions.en: We have gathered the remains of alien weaponry used in extensive weapon testing on [From.GetName] for analysis.

descriptions.zh: 在[time_loop_world.GetName]上保护着有鳞族智慧文明的远古护盾正因热量与缺乏修理而开裂。我们必须修复它。
descriptions.en: The ancient shield enclosing the sapient squamate civilization on [time_loop_world.GetName] is cracking from heat and disrepair. We must restore it.

descriptions.zh: 我们准备了一个打断时空循环的计划。
descriptions.en: We have prepared a project to interrupt the time loop.

descriptions.zh: 一个神秘的外星生物进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，我们最好尽快确认该外星生物来此的目的。
descriptions.en: A mysterious alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName]. It would be wise to determine its purpose here as soon as possible.

descriptions.zh: 外星存在巴铎尔43号表示，它可以使用催眠教学法，也就是休眠学习的方式对我们的民族进行提升。我们的科研人员必须要紧密监视整个过程才行。
descriptions.en: The alien entity BALDOR XXXXIII claims that it can uplift our people using hypnopedia, rest-learning. Our researchers will have to monitor the process closely.

descriptions.zh: 我们的飞升进程由于巴铎尔43号发生的严重硬件故障而受阻。其实体必须立即修复。
descriptions.en: Our ascension is being jeopardized by a critical hardware failure in Baldor XXXXIII. The entity requires immediate repairs.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了用未知材料建成的金字塔型的隐藏建筑——西万实验室。这些实验室被层层的沙土所掩埋，在进行探索之前我们必须将覆盖这些设施的沙土清理干净，如果叛军们的推测没错的话，实验室中藏有威力强大的武器，绝对值得我们花大力气将其找出。
descriptions.en: We have located the Xvan Labs - a hidden gathering of pyramidic structures built from an unknown material, submerged under layers of sand and dust. We will have to excavate the facilities before we can explore them, but if the rebels were correct in their assumptions, the weapons within will be worth their while.

descriptions.zh: 某个未知帝国打算用某种干扰光束来骇入远古L-星门网络，但他们在骇入过程中遭到了攻击，光束也被损坏，我们也许能修复那个光束。
descriptions.en: An unknown empire was attempting to hack into the ancient L-Gate Network using an interference beam when they were attacked and the beam damaged. Perhaps the beam could be restored.

descriptions.zh: 虚空孳孽的卵进化出了通过吸收邻近恒星的能源来忍受严酷太空环境的能力。或许这些碎片可以揭露它的秘密。
descriptions.en: Somehow the Voidspawn egg has evolved to survive the harsh conditions of space, by absorbing and conserving huge amounts of solar energy. Maybe the remains of the shattered shards could reveal its secrets.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]现在已经构想出了一项大胆的计划用于复活缇扬奇族母，这样她就能效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗了。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] have hatched an audacious plan to bring the Tiyanki Matriarch back from the dead, so she may serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

titles.zh: 复活被杀死的虚空孳孽

descriptions.zh: [Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证他们能通过某些不可告人的方式将§Y虚空孳孽§!复活，并使其效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗。
descriptions.en: Through methods best not spoken of aloud, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that they are capable of resurrecting the §YVoidspawn§! to serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们确实不太清楚其中的门道，但在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]的带领下，我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝世的变形虫重返世间了。
descriptions.en: We do not quite understand it but headed by [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们不太清楚其中的门道，但我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝去的变形虫重返世间了。
descriptions.en: We do not quite understand it but our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.

sections.zh: 尽管我们确实不太清楚其中的门道，但在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]的带领下，我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝世的变形虫重返世间了。
sections.en: We do not quite understand it but headed by [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.

sections.zh: 尽管我们不太清楚其中的门道，但我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝去的变形虫重返世间了。
sections.en: We do not quite understand it but our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.

descriptions.zh: 初步报告显示这星球上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。研究员提议组织进一步在轨研究以更加深入了解这种神秘生物。
descriptions.en: Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering this planet is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before. Researchers propose an extended orbital study be organized in order to learn more about this mysterious being.
